scientific_question: Can a full dense linear map on the MLP branch immediately before the identity residual addition repair the residual-coordinate direction mismatch left by the compact full-MLP family?

architecture.moe_placement: after the probability-weighted routed-expert sum, so one FC is shared by all experts in a layer
architecture.attention_scope: excluded from the first discriminator; test the MLP residual write first
architecture.distinction_from_prior_residual_write_ru: The prior residual-write-preserving joint run retained dense attention c_proj and dense MLP c_proj. It did not add or test a learned post-branch FC on a compact MLP output.

can_change: the residual-stream output basis and scale of the already formed branch
the left/output factor of the branch Jacobian
cannot_change: the hidden-coordinate row space of an already formed c_proj
algebraic_scope.linear_mlp_invariant: For F(x)=B phi(Ax), C_l F(x)=(C_l B)phi(Ax), and rowspace(C_l B) is contained in rowspace(B).

frozen_evidence.interpretation: Residual writes have a stable shared output atlas, so a shared post-branch FC is evidence-aligned. The low node-private JVP also proves that an output FC cannot by itself cure the binding pre-GELU normal-field defect.

oracle_protocol.parent: sealed 124M/5TPP repaired-attention full-MLP endpoint and its matched dense/repaired-attention controls
oracle_protocol.data: two independent discovery banks and untouched fixed heldout validation batches
oracle_protocol.fit: ridge-fit C on the candidate branch outputs with an explicitly weighted analytic input-JVP term; never fit on heldout targets
arms: one unrestricted C_l per layer as a nondeployable structural ceiling
one globally shared C with layerwise input/output diagonal modulation as the >=200x-compatible arm
primary_metrics: heldout validation CE after sequential block intervention

decision_rule.layer_private_failure: Reject a post-branch FC as the MLP solution; it cannot recover information absent from F_l.
decision_rule.layer_private_pass_shared_failure: Record an output-direction solution that is incompatible with the >=200x trainable-state objective; do not launch training.
decision_rule.shared_pass: Implement the shared identity-initialized FC plus layer modulation, run an exact-config foreground MFU gate, and only then launch the 124M 0.5TPP causal discriminator.
